capabilities: preview notes as the InkStone site renders them, live on save
navigate two-way between the editor and preview links
scaffold site notes (homepage, page, book, listing, feed, translations, language variants)
toggle between visitor and Owner view of private pages
commit, pull and push the site folder from a Git panel
disambiguation: Does not deploy or host the site; it only previews InkStone's local output and pushes changes to Git.
extras: Early release (0.x); desktop only, tested on macOS and Linux, Windows untested live. Supports pre-releases via BRAT. The author discloses that rendered pages may load external resources (e.g. Giscus) and that the plugin runs Python and git as child processes.
intentEvidence: The plugin never re-implements rendering. It's InkStone's own output.
problem: Obsidian's reading view renders notes differently from InkStone, so site authors had to commit, push and deploy just to see how a post will look.

relations.evidence: it runs InkStone on your machine and shows the actual rendered page

summary: Live preview pane that renders notes exactly as the author's InkStone site does, plus note scaffolding and a Git commit-and-push panel.
